abstract: ASET defines an open, implementation-neutral accountability semantics that binds authority, context, proposals, permits, gates, transitions and evidence into verifiable trails for heterogeneous systems composed of people, AI agents, organizations and software services.

about.description: ASET is an open specification and reference implementation for Authority-Signed Evidence Trails, enabling verifiable accountability within heterogeneous sociotechnical systems.
